question: Photo 06 shows one of three identical oriels (Fifth pairs 1, 4, 7). Which one?
pair1: excluded: the photo shows full arcade arches two pairs north of the oriel; under pair 1 that would be pair -1, where the prow is.

rooftop_rig_boom.reading: Under pair 4 the davit boom seen in 06 lands 0.7 m from rig R2 in photo 07 (taken 3 min earlier); under pair 7 no 06 feature lines up with any 07 rig.

shadow_edge_at_arcade.reading: The cast-shadow edge crossing the arcade should move well under 1 m in 3 minutes. Pair 4 leaves a 7.5 m mismatch (plausible given steep-view solve error along a diagonal edge); pair 7 leaves 24 m.

cross_photo_checks.timestamps: 05 at the centre entrance 10:56:41, 06 at 10:57:44: both pair 4 (23 m walk) and pair 7 (40 m) are plausible, so timestamps do not decide.

verdict: pair 4, moderate confidence (two independent cross-photo checks against photo 07 favour it; neither is exact).
method: Ray-plane intersection of annotated pixels with the Fifth facade plane (x=-13.1 m, cornice x=-14.6 m) using each solved camera.
